data.name: Mojiworld
data.detailed_description:
Remember when worlds felt endless?

Mojiworld is a love letter to the golden age of side-scrolling MMOs — rebuilt as a single-player adventure you can sink into tonight. Every tile, tree, and townsfolk is hand-pixeled. Every corner hums with that warm, early-2000s "one more map" feeling.

⚔️ PICK YOUR PATH
Choose from MULTIPLE classes, each with its own feel, skills, and playstyle. Swing, snipe, cast, or heal your way across the world — and make the build yours.

🗺️ EXPLORE A HAND-PIXELED CONTINENT
Journey through the various continents — rolling meadows, buzzing towns, and dungeons that reward the curious. No waypoint-chasing. Just you, the map, and the urge to see what's past the next screen.

🌐 AND THIS IS ONLY CHAPTER ONE
Mojiworld launches as a complete single-player adventure — but the world is built for more.

Play the world solo first. Meet everyone else there later!

The full online MMORPG follows after a successful launch: stay tuned for guilds, raids, and a living world shared with other players.

✨ FEATURES

  • Multiple playable classes, each hand-crafted

  • A fully hand-pixeled world in the spirit of early-2000s side-scrollers

  • Cozy life moments — fishing, exploring, just being there

  • Single-player with co-op at launch; full MMORPG planned as a free evolution of the world

  • Multiple continents planned — the adventure keeps growing

  • Made with love by Moji Studios, an indie team devoted to the early-2000s era

data.short_description: Mojiworld is a hand-pixeled 2D side-scrolling adventure that feels like the 2000s never ended. Pick one of the 4 main classes, wander a cozy, chibi-forward world, fish at dawn, and grow stronger — solo today, with a full online MMORPG world coming after launch.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (6th gen / 2015+) or AMD FX-6300 — any dual-core 2.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics — Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon equivalent (DX11-class, 512 MB). No dedicated GPU required
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device (integrated audio is fine)
  • VR Support: 64-bit OS required. Keyboard & mouse or a Steam-supported gamepad. Online co-op needs a broadband connection; single-player is fully offline after install.
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection (online co-op only; solo play runs offline)
